notes.title: RED SNOW Developer Live Stream PART 2!
notes.content:
Ask your burning questions about RED SNOW - the world's bloodiest snowboarding game!

Hang out with the game's lead developer, Charlie Dolphin, as he goes for 100% completion of the Red Snow Demo, again! We're going for every achievement, every unlockable, and the highest of kill counts in this insane winter-sports marathon.

Don't forget to follow [url=https://x.com/playRedSnow]@playRedSnow[/url] on twitter/X for the latest development updates!

See you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2809120/Red_Snow/
